historical_reproduction.provenance_note: Only K=2-5 are present in the frozen executable notebooks. K=6-8 are not traceable and must not appear in regenerated Table S1.

fresh_refit.scope: Uniform multi-seed screening grid for fresh K comparisons and Editor Concern #2 robustness refits
fresh_refit.limitation: These are screening-depth single-chain fits repeated across three deterministic seeds; R-hat is not estimable and the deeper archived eICU fits remain the primary K-selection provenance evidence.

deep_refit.scope: Prespecified deep multi-initialization confirmation of K=2 versus K=3 and all screening-depth CAUTION scenarios.
deep_refit.limitation: Each seed is an independent single-chain initialization. Mixture labels are aligned before cross-seed comparison; conventional multi-chain R-hat is not reported because label switching prevents direct untreated chain pooling. Every prespecified seed, including degenerate or poorly mixing fits, remains in the denominator.

posterior_assignment.uncertainty_rule: 95% HPD lower bound for the selected component must exceed 0.5

diagnostics.single_chain_limitation: R-hat is not estimable for the archived one-chain reproduction. Multi-seed revision experiments are reported separately.
